title: Charles River Associates (CRA) to Present at Upcoming Investor Conferences
summary: BOSTON --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 17, 2026-- Charles River Associates (NASDAQ: CRAI), a worldwide leader in providing economic, financial, and management consulting services, today announced that the Company will present at the following investor conferences.
body_markdown:
[PDF Version](https://crainternationalinc.gcs-web.com/node/21906/pdf)


BOSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 17, 2026--[Charles River Associates](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.crai.com%2F&esheet=54605532&newsitemid=20260917629460&lan=en-US&anchor=Charles+River+Associates&index=1&md5=c074d64605039aba49ddf217e6db8002) (NASDAQ: CRAI), a worldwide leader in providing[economic, financial, and management consulting services](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.crai.com%2F&esheet=54605532&newsitemid=20260917629460&lan=en-US&anchor=economic%2C+financial%2C+and+management+consulting+services&index=2&md5=c45c496d14c3ec77efd7543e3e6cf7f2) , today announced that the Company will present at the following investor conferences. CRA Chairman and Chief Executive Officer[Paul Maleh](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.crai.com%2Four-people%2Fpaul-maleh%2F&esheet=54605532&newsitemid=20260917629460&lan=en-US&anchor=Paul+Maleh&index=3&md5=fd73407b368b51f2ef26e5f8c02026fc) is scheduled to present at both events. Mr. Maleh, along with[Eric Nierenberg](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.crai.com%2Four-people%2Feric-nierenberg%2F&esheet=54605532&newsitemid=20260917629460&lan=en-US&anchor=Eric+Nierenberg&index=4&md5=898b8b4f1bae1f484dc8a567e4076471) , Chief Financial Officer, and[Chad Holmes,](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.crai.com%2Four-people%2Fchad-holmes%2F&esheet=54605532&newsitemid=20260917629460&lan=en-US&anchor=Chad+Holmes%2C&index=5&md5=be78ba83ab8f18d816d374192e5bfaae) Chief Corporate Development Officer, will be available for virtual meetings with investors during both conferences.


**Sidoti Small Cap Virtual Conference** Dates: September 23 and 24, 2026
Presentation: 10:00 a.m. EDT, Wednesday, September 23


**Noble Capital Markets Emerging Growth Virtual Equity Conference** Dates: October 1 and 2, 2026
Presentation: 9:00 a.m. EDT, Thursday, October 1


A live webcast of the Sidoti presentation will be available on the Company’s[investor relations website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.crai.com%2F&esheet=54605532&newsitemid=20260917629460&lan=en-US&anchor=investor+relations+website&index=6&md5=761fc07d455958941b4c259287f2ee3b) . An archived replay will be available after the presentation. An archived replay of the Noble presentation will be available on the investor relations website after the live event.


**About Charles River Associates (CRA)** Charles River Associates® is a leading global consulting firm specializing in[economic, financial, and management consulting services](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.crai.com%2F&esheet=54605532&newsitemid=20260917629460&lan=en-US&anchor=economic%2C+financial%2C+and+management+consulting+services&index=7&md5=3ff096ba81c35402b5a8a593f4ea619d) . CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its unique combination of functional expertise and industry knowledge, and for its objective solutions to complex problems. Headquartered in Boston, CRA has offices throughout the world. Detailed information about Charles River Associates, a registered trade name of CRA International, Inc., is available at[www.crai.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.crai.com%2F&esheet=54605532&newsitemid=20260917629460&lan=en-US&anchor=www.crai.com&index=8&md5=f8c0e282271374f047e658f6ce5daed6) .
